title: 五庄观修果枝
subtitle: 犯错之后，认真照顾比藏起来更勇敢
origin: 《西游记》第二十四至二十六回（低龄温和改编补遗）

moral.zh: 说出错误只是开始；愿意学习正确方法、一起修复，才能重新建立信任。
moral.en: Admitting a mistake is the beginning. Learning the right repair and doing it together rebuilds trust.

pages.zh: 人参果树的嫩枝被碰弯后，悟空主动把经过告诉镇元大仙。
pages.en: After a young branch bent, Wukong told Immortal Zhenyuan exactly what had happened.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_HEADBAND]] Wukong speaks honestly with open empty hands beside a gently bent glowing fruit-tree branch; staff upright in a distant rack.

pages.zh: 镇元大仙没有让他马上拉直：“嫩枝需要托住，不是用力拽。”
pages.en: Zhenyuan did not let him pull it straight. “A young branch needs support, not force.”
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_HEADBAND]] A kind elderly Taoist gardener in pale teal robes demonstrates supporting a soft practice twig with both palms; Wukong watches.

pages.zh: 八戒找来软布，沙僧削平木片，唐僧把周围的人请到树影外等候。
pages.en: Bajie brought soft cloth, Sha smoothed wooden splints, and Tang Seng cleared a quiet working space.
pages.prompt: [[TANG_SENG]] [[BAJIE]] [[SHA_WUJING]] The team prepares soft cloth strips and rounded wooden splints on a padded tray; no sharp tools or crowding.

pages.zh: 悟空托住枝条，镇元大仙把木片放在两侧，再用软布松松固定。
pages.en: Wukong supported the branch while Zhenyuan placed splints on both sides and tied them loosely with cloth.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_HEADBAND]] Wukong gently supports the glowing branch with both hands while the elderly gardener applies rounded splints and soft cloth; no staff in hand.

pages.zh: 他们在树下围出一圈彩绳，提醒大家这几天从旁边绕行。
pages.en: They placed a ring of colored rope beneath the tree so everyone would take another path for a few days.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_HEADBAND]] [[TANG_SENG]] [[BAJIE]] [[SHA_WUJING]] Team places a low colorful boundary rope and a picture-only leaf marker around the resting branch.

pages.zh: 悟空每天来看湿度、松紧和新芽，从不因为着急就多绑一层。
pages.en: Each day Wukong checked moisture, tightness, and new buds without adding extra ties in impatience.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_HEADBAND]] Wukong uses a small wooden moisture bead and gently checks the loose cloth tie; fresh buds visible, staff shrunk behind ear.

pages.zh: 第七天，嫩枝重新抬起头。镇元大仙请悟空亲手拆下软布。
pages.en: On the seventh day, the branch lifted again, and Zhenyuan invited Wukong to remove the cloth.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_HEADBAND]] Wukong carefully unwraps the soft cloth from a healthy upright branch while the elderly gardener and team smile.

pages.zh: 悟空把木片收进工具篮：“修好不是忘掉错误，而是记住以后怎样照顾。”
pages.en: Wukong returned the splints to the tool basket. “Repair means remembering how to care better next time.”
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_HEADBAND]] Wukong places rounded splints and folded cloth into a basket beneath the glowing healthy tree; staff upright beside the path.
